modInfo: I used google maps to be more accurate, so if you want to see for yourself, just write down Midway Island in the search bar.
Even if the map is small, there are some vehicles. I will continue to add details over time, also following your advice.
How long can you survive on your own, in a desert island where all the inhabitants are dead and are trying to eat you?
I wanted to test my skills, inserting everything I needed, food, seeds, tools, etc. If any fundamental building is missing, do not hesitate to tell me and I will add it. See you soon!
